veranderings.blok: Drie punte om na 'n dans te kyk
veranderings.voor: onder wie die dans gegroei het
veranderings.na: onder wie die dans ontwikkel het
veranderings.rede: A dance 'ontwikkel' rather than 'groei' in natural Afrikaans; the same change is proposed in the two later blocks and should be kept or dropped together for consistency.
Same as block one: 'ontwikkel' is the natural verb for a dance taking shape; keep consistent with the other two.
'rondom' is clearer for a Grade 5 reader than bare 'om' for 'around' a place.
'daarna' can be read as 'afterwards'; 'dit' refers clearly to the dance, as 'skoolspanne dans dit' does just before.

veranderings.blok: Gumboot-dans: hoe dit lyk en klink
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two sentences with their own subject and verb (hulle dans / 'n kitaar speel), so a comma goes before it.
Same as the gumboot block: 'ontwikkel' is the natural verb; keep consistent with the other two.

veranderings.voor: Langs mekaar wys die drie punte hoe verskillend die twee danse is.
veranderings.na: Die drie punte wys hoe verskillend die twee danse langs mekaar is.
veranderings.rede: As written, 'langs mekaar' attaches to the three points rather than the two dances; the reorder fixes the reference without adding words.
'die meeste' needs a countable plural; 'ballette' (ballet works) keeps the qualifier and reads naturally.
It is the dancers, not the dance, that stamp; clearer for Grade 5 and matches 'gumboot-dansers skop ook hoog' later in the block.
Same as the previous sentence: the dancers try to look light, not the dance; keeps the pair parallel.

veranderings.voor: Dit is die klem en nie die enigste
veranderings.na: Dit is die klem, nie die enigste
veranderings.rede: 'en nie' makes the contrast read like an addition; a comma states the contrast directly and saves a word.
The fixed expression is 'in karakter bly'; 'in sy karakter' sounds like his personality, and the change saves a word.
